blocked.name: Hushbringer
blocked.why: Not reached. Researched: `suppressEntryTriggers` (Torpor Orb: `{ who: "everyone", entering: { type: "creature" } }`) is checked in trigger detection for the `permanent-entered-battlefield` event only (`Game.entryTriggersSuppressed`). Dying needs the same check for a creature's death, read as it last existed: `dies` triggers, `leaves-battlefield` triggers when it left by dying, and "put into a graveyard from the battlefield" triggers (the rulings) — but not `sacrifice` or `destroyed` triggers (an event that causes the death still triggers), and a graveyard-from-anywhere trigger only while Hushbringer is still on the battlefield afterwards and the ability isn't the dying card's own. A Hushbringer dying at the same time still suppresses (look back, as `triggerDoublers` reads a departed source), batched "one or more die" triggers leave the suppressed creatures out.
